The '''Sevarin Mesa Windfarms''' was a windfarming complex built in the [[Shattered Basin]] in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was named after the [[Sevarin Mesa]], which formed the western wall of the Basin, and the facility's windmills were built atop the mesa.
